parole.significato: A Malay rice platter consisting of an assortment of meat and vegetable dishes, usually shared among four or five people.
parole.testo: Malay nasi (“rice”) + Javanese ꦲꦩ꧀ꦧꦼꦁ (ambeng, “food offering served on a tray”)
